key_insight: Guided-RLVR uses a lightweight controller to steer sampling toward diverse reasoning paths, countering the narrow exploration that can arise in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.
engineering_relevance: The approach could improve mathematical reasoning and code generation by broadening exploration during reinforcement learning.
method: Augment RLVR with a lightweight controller.
Inject semantically meaningful steering tokens into the sampling distribution.
Encourage multiple reasoning perspectives to expand exploration.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent improvements over existing RLVR methods on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, alongside more diverse reasoning trajectories, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Controller overhead and sensitivity to steering-token selection are not quantified in the abstract.
paper_title: Guided-RLVR: Guided Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
